🎥🎬: Uninvited Guest (2004)

When a mysterious stranger named Simon arrives at the home of a seemingly happy couple, their peaceful domestic life begins to unravel. What initially appears to be an innocent visit soon develops into an unsettling situation as Simon becomes increasingly comfortable in their home, interfering with their relationship and exposing tensions they have tried to keep hidden.

As his presence grows more intrusive, the couple begins questioning his intentions and struggling to regain control of their own lives. What makes the situation even more disturbing is how easily an outsider can manipulate the trust and comfort that once held their relationship together.

As secrets emerge and tensions escalate, the boundaries between hospitality, obsession, and danger become increasingly blurred. Uninvited Guest explores the unsettling consequences of allowing the wrong person into your life.
